prompts.name: high_five
prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent sprite sheet for a tiny personal Cinnamoroll desktop companion. Reference 1 is STRICT character and drawing style: white puppy, very long floppy ears, bright blue oval eyes, pink cheeks, tiny brown mouth, fine warm cinnamon-brown outlines, soft clean white shading, small curled tail. Reference 2 is only a prop reference for the cinnamon roll. Exactly TWO arms, TWO feet, TWO ears, no duplicate limbs. Exactly EIGHT full-body frames in FOUR columns TWO rows, same size/camera and ground baseline in all frames, 40px transparent gutters inside EVERY cell, max75% cell width, full ears and feet visible. Genuine transparent background, clean alpha, no labels/text/grid/shadows/background/human hand/cursor/disconnected specks. Smooth gentle eight-frame action with recognizable distinct poses. 
Action: Friendly HIGH FIVE: one paw raises beside face palm forward, leans a tiny bit to meet the viewer, happy closed-eye smile at contact, paw settles and lowers. Other paw stays at tummy. Frame1 neutral,2 raise,3 ready,4 contact,5 happy,6 hold,7 lower,8 neutral. No actual human hand.
